page_titles.title: Data Transfer
page_titles.subtitle: Import and export module data across the platform as portable JSON transfer files.

labels.import_description: Replay a module transfer file through the owning module's own admin actions.
labels.export_description: Download a module's data as a transfer file: request-shaped payloads in dependency order.
labels.duplicate_strategy: Existing records with the same key
labels.row_cap_exceeded: The file exceeds the {{cap}} row limit.
labels.history_description: Import runs across all modules, latest first.

help_texts.import: Pick a JSON transfer file produced by an export on this or another store. Sections are replayed in dependency order; rows matching existing records follow the duplicate strategy. Binary files never travel — media references stay identifiers.
help_texts.export: Downloads a module's data as a versioned transfer file you can re-import on any store. Ids stay source-store ids; the import remaps them.
help_texts.dry_run: Validates every row and reports the outcome without writing anything.
